source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction; Form MO-A PDF p2 Part 1 Line 18; instructions PDF p16 Line 18; record capital_gains capital_gain_subtraction

worked: Single, age 60. All gains are subtracted on Part 1 Line 18, so they are out of Line 6 and do not count against the limit; the projection's measure is federal AGI less capital_gain_subtraction (measure.minus_reliefs). Federal AGI 54,000 would be over it. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 19,000.00 + pensions 5,000.00 + short-term gains 10,000.00 + long-term gains 20,000.00 = 54,000.00. Federal taxable income = 54,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 38,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 54,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 54,000.00. Line 4 subtractions: MO-A Part 1 Line 18 capital gain (federal Line 7a 30,000.00) 30,000.00 (capital_gain_subtraction); total 30,000.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 54,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 24,000.00. Section B: Line 1 24,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 24,000.00; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 0.00; Line 6Y 5,000.00, Line 7Y 5,000.00; Line 8 5,000.00; Line 9 5,000.00. Projection measure: federal AGI 54,000.00 - capital_gain_subtraction 30,000.00 - taxable Social Security 0.00 = 24,000.00, not over 25,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 5,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 24,000.00 - 5,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 3,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 3,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 624.00 = 15.6; total 41.86 = 41.86. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 42; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 24,000.00 - Line 8 5,000.00 = 19,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 24,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
